product_overview: XQAP is a fully client-side Arabic RTL web app for radiology/cargo X-ray quality assurance teams. Users choose a local workspace folder, sign in with client-side roles, and access role-based tabs for quality assurance workflows, settings, notifications, and admin tools.
core_goals: Choose or open a local workspace to use the app
Sign in with a managed user account and access role-based tabs
Switch between available tabs to use workspace tools
Customize UI labels and admin settings
Send feedback and use accessibility-friendly keyboard interactions

features.name: Workspace folder picker / unsupported browser gate
features.description: On first load, the app prompts the user to choose a workspace folder on their device. If the browser does not support the required file system access, the app shows an explicit unsupported-browser state instead of the main workspace flow.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the workspace entry screen -> Choose a folder for the workspace -> Enter the app with the selected workspace
Navigate to / -> See the workspace entry screen -> Try to use the app in an unsupported browser -> See the unsupported-browser state

features.name: Login screen (client-side auth)
features.description: The app provides a username and password login form for managed users, with inline validation feedback and a temporary lockout after repeated failed attempts. It also includes a hidden bootstrap-admin passcode entry path for admin setup.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the signed-in workspace shell
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See an inline Arabic error message
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Repeatedly submit invalid credentials -> See a temporary lockout with a countdown
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Trigger the hidden admin shortcut -> See the bootstrap-admin passcode modal -> Enter the passcode or cancel the modal

features.name: Role/permission-gated tab shell and navigation
features.description: After login, the app shows a role-based sidebar of permitted tabs. The user can switch between tabs, collapse the sidebar, and use the mobile sidebar controls without leaving the current page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Click a permitted tab in the sidebar -> See the selected tab content replace the previous content
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Collapse the sidebar -> Expand the sidebar again -> Continue navigating tabs
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in on mobile -> Open the sidebar from the menu control -> Close the sidebar by tapping outside it -> See the shell remain on the current tab
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in with a role that has no permitted tabs -> See the no-available-tabs empty state

features.name: Boot splash / data-source checklist overlay
features.description: While a tab is loading its own workspace data sources, the app shows a non-blocking boot checklist overlay over the content area. The overlay clears once the tab finishes loading.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Open a tab that is still loading -> See the boot checklist overlay appear over the content area -> Wait for loading to finish -> See the overlay disappear

features.name: Admin role-preview toolbar
features.description: For admin users, the top toolbar lets them preview the app as other roles, log out, and toggle the feedback widget.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in as admin -> Switch the role preview to another role -> See the sidebar and available tabs update for that role
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in as admin -> Click logout -> Return to the login flow
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in as admin -> Toggle feedback on -> See the feedback widget open -> Toggle feedback off -> See the widget close

features.name: Feedback widget
features.description: Signed-in users can open a floating feedback widget, enter free-text feedback, submit it, and close the widget.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Open the floating feedback widget -> Type feedback text -> Submit the feedback -> See the widget remain usable for further input
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Open the floating feedback widget -> Close the widget

features.name: Settings tab and label customization
features.description: The settings area lets authorized users customize UI labels and adjust app-level settings such as the bootstrap-admin passcode and whether username login is allowed. Label changes are persisted and reflected immediately in the interface.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in with access to Settings -> Open the Settings tab -> Edit a label override value -> Save the change -> See the updated label reflected elsewhere in the UI

Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in with access to Settings -> Open the Settings tab -> Change an admin-account setting such as the bootstrap-admin passcode or username-login allowance -> Save the setting

features.name: Notification banner / notification center
features.description: The app can display workspace-wide notifications as a dismissible banner and in a dedicated notification center tab where the user can review notification history and acknowledge items.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> View an active notification banner -> Dismiss the notification
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Open the notification center tab -> Review notification history -> Acknowledge a notification

features.name: Accessibility and keyboard focus handling
features.description: The app supports keyboard navigation, modal focus trapping, Escape-to-close behavior, focus return to the opener, and aria-live announcements for important status messages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Tab through the login form -> Observe the focus order through the fields and controls

Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Open the admin modal -> Tab through the modal controls -> Confirm focus stays trapped inside the modal -> Press Escape -> See the modal close and focus return to the opener
Navigate to / -> Choose a workspace folder -> Sign in -> Navigate the sidebar and tab list using the keyboard

routes.description: Single-page app root. Renders WorkspacePicker -> AuthGate -> WorkspaceGate -> AppContent. No client-side router; navigation is tab-state based, not URL based.

features.name: Workspace folder picker / unsupported browser gate
features.description: On load, the app tries to mount a workspace folder via the File System Access API (showDirectoryPicker). Non-Chromium browsers or environments without the API hit an unsupported_browser state screen instead of the picker.
user_interactions: Land on the app with no workspace folder selected
See "choose folder" / "try demo" entry screen
Attempt folder selection (native picker cannot be automated by a browser test agent)
Observe unsupported-browser messaging when the File System Access API is absent

features.name: Login screen (client-side auth)
features.description: Username/password login form for managed users, plus a hidden Alt+A/Alt+T (or Arabic "شف") keyboard shortcut that opens a bootstrap-admin passcode modal. No backend call; credentials are checked against in-memory/workspace-synced user records with Argon2id/PBKDF2 hashes.
user_interactions: Fill username input field
Fill password input field, toggle password visibility (eye icon)
Submit login form
See inline error message on invalid credentials (Arabic, aria-live)
Trigger 3-attempt lockout with 30s countdown after repeated failures
Use "change folder" / "clear session" / "forget user" footer actions
Trigger hidden admin shortcut (Alt+A, Alt+T, or "شف") to open bootstrap-admin passcode modal
Submit or cancel the bootstrap-admin modal (Enter submits, Escape cancels, focus trap enforced)

features.name: Role/permission-gated tab shell and navigation
features.description: After login, a sidebar lists tabs filtered by the session's role (guest/employee/supervisor/manager/admin) and a role->tab permission matrix. Selecting a tab swaps visible content without a page reload; at most 3 tabs stay mounted (LRU).
user_interactions: Click a sidebar tab to switch active content
Collapse/expand the sidebar
Open mobile sidebar via hamburger button, close via backdrop click
See "no available tabs" empty state for a role with nothing permitted
Observe RTL layout (dir="rtl") and Arabic labels throughout

features.name: Boot splash / data-source checklist overlay
features.description: A post-login overlay shown over the active tab's content area while that tab's own boot sources (e.g. month data) are still loading; never blocks the sidebar/toolbar.
user_interactions: Observe the checklist overlay appear once per login/workspace session
Observe it disappear once all registered sources report loaded (or error, non-blocking)

features.name: Admin role-preview toolbar
features.description: Sticky top toolbar (admin only) with a segmented control to preview the app as another role, a logout button, and a feedback toggle.
user_interactions: Switch role-preview segment (guest/employee/supervisor/manager/admin)
Click logout
Click feedback toggle to open/close FeedbackWidget

features.name: Feedback widget
features.description: Floating widget for submitting free-text feedback, stored to the feedback data module.
user_interactions: Open floating feedback button
Type feedback text and submit
Close widget

features.name: Settings tab and label customization
features.description: Available to guest and admin roles. Lets an admin override any UI label key (persisted to localStorage) without touching source, and manage app-level settings (e.g. bootstrap-admin passcode, allow-username-login toggle).
user_interactions: Open Settings tab
Edit a label override value and save
See the label change reflected live elsewhere in the UI
Toggle admin-account settings (passcode, username-login allowance)

features.name: Notification banner / notification center
features.description: Workspace-wide broadcast notifications with per-recipient acknowledgement, shown as a dismissible banner and a dedicated tab.
user_interactions: View active notification banner
Dismiss/acknowledge a notification
Open notification center tab and review notification history

features.name: Accessibility and keyboard focus handling
features.description: Focus trap on modals (bootstrap-admin passcode modal), aria-live regions for auth messages, aria-hidden/inert on backdrop content while mobile sidebar or modals are open, keyboard shortcuts.
user_interactions: Tab through the login form and verify focus order
Open the admin modal and confirm Tab is trapped inside it
Press Escape to close the modal and confirm focus returns to the trigger element
Navigate the sidebar and tab list via keyboard

known_limitations.issue: No backend and no URL-based routing; all navigation is in-memory tab state, so a test cannot deep-link to a specific tab via URL.
known_limitations.impact: Test plans must drive navigation through UI clicks (sidebar tab selection) rather than direct URLs.

known_limitations.issue: Most business-data tabs (Population, Employee Workspace, Reports, Archive, User Management, Ad-hoc Import) require a mounted workspace directory handle from the File System Access API.
known_limitations.impact: A browser automation agent cannot complete the native OS folder picker, so full data-workflow testing (import, sampling, distribution, reporting) is not reachable in this run; testing is scoped to the pre-workspace and shell-level screens.

known_limitations.issue: Security model is advisory only -- all auth/role checks run client-side and business data is plain JSON with no server-side enforcement.
known_limitations.impact: Auth is a UX/role-routing guard, not a trust boundary; not a target for security-bypass style test cases.

known_limitations.issue: The app requires a Chromium-based browser (showDirectoryPicker); other browsers hit an unsupported_browser state.
known_limitations.impact: Cross-browser compatibility testing outside Chromium should expect the unsupported-browser screen, not app functionality.
